channel.title: WillowinWorld Devlog
channel.description: Latest production notes for WillowinWorld mobile games.

item.title: Nature Seed: Level 2 restoration and stability pass
item.description: Level 2 now uses its production background pair while level construction and win-collision handling were tightened for a more predictable restore-and-complete flow.

item.title: Candy Shop: Production menu and HUD pass
item.description: Main menu, level selection, HUD controls and command icons now share one clearer visual language, backed by expanded play-mode stress coverage.

item.title: Paint Blasters: Physics and effect stability pass
item.description: Projectile, Match-3, VFX, physics queries and pooled hit buffers were tightened under the production validator for more predictable combo resolution.

item.title: Ball is God?!: World surfaces and hazard validation
item.description: Character surfaces across the ten-location build, deterministic generation and thorn hazards received a coordinated art-and-production test pass.
